Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1271
Claimant:
Jeffrey Esparza
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
January 6, 2025
First notice of loss received from the insured's agent reporting a side impact at a controlled intersection, with the
claimant's vehicle struck on the driver's side. The claimant has retained counsel, and all contact will be routed through
the attorney's office going forward.
February 7, 2025
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle at the scene and lists the other driver as cited for
failing to yield. Confirmed the claimant was present in the vehicle at the time of the collision.
February 24, 2025
Photos submitted by the insured show the impact area and confirm several of the damage details described in the
initial report. No independent witnesses have come forward to date.
February 27, 2025
Inspected the vehicle with the repair estimator. The damage is largely consistent with the described impact direction
and angle. Nothing in the inspection suggests prior damage to the same panels, and no earlier repairs were found on
record.
March 14, 2025
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was active on the date of loss. Found nothing indicating
the damage predates the start of coverage.
March 31, 2025
Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness following the collision and has been seen by a treating physician. The
reported injury fits well with the force and type of impact shown in the photos and the estimate.
April 15, 2025
Medical records reviewed. Claimant has a past history of a minor strain in the same region several years ago, which
resolved fully with no lasting limitation noted in the file.
May 8, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a cervical strain of this kind. Requested updated
treatment notes and therapy attendance records from the provider through counsel.
June 7, 2025
Spoke with the claimant on two occasions. The account of how the collision happened has stayed the same in each
conversation, with no material differences in sequnece or description.
July 31, 2025
Received the requested treatment records and the repair estimate. Reviewed both against the police report and
photos and noted the findings for the file. Medical bills are being reviewed for reasonableness.
August 22, 2025
File remains open pending receipt of the final treatment summary and the attorney's settlement demand. Next review
scheduled once those documents are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
